channel.title: polymarket-tui blog
channel.description: Notes on prediction markets and trading them from the terminal.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Reopening Odds on Polymarket: August 2026
item.description: Polymarket prices a 15.5c chance Hormuz shipping normalizes by August 31, after a Houthi tanker attack and Trump's 'reopening soon' comments this week.

item.title: Reading the Polymarket Trade Tape
item.description: A resting order is an offer; a print is a fact. How to read Polymarket's trade tape - aggressor side, size, and clustering - alongside the order book.

item.title: Michigan Democratic Senate Primary Odds on Polymarket: August 2026
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's Polymarket win probability swung from 81c to a 63c low to 98c ahead of today's Michigan Senate primary. Here's what moved it, in the order book.

item.title: Limit vs. Market Orders on Polymarket
item.description: Polymarket has no market-order button - a "market" order is a limit order priced to cross the spread, killed instead of rested. Here's what that means for fills.

item.title: Iran Strike Cancellation Odds on Polymarket: August 2026
item.description: Trump called off a planned US-Israel bombing campaign on Iran after a Hormuz Strait compromise. Polymarket's ceasefire ladder jumped 19-31c across every date.

item.title: Hamas Disarmament Deal Odds on Polymarket: August 2026
item.description: Trump's Board of Peace announced a Hamas disarmament breakthrough on July 30. Polymarket's disarm-by-Dec-31 market spiked to 93c, then crashed to 61c as Israel rejected the terms.

item.title: NVIDIA Overtakes Apple: Polymarket's Largest-Company Odds
item.description: Apple beat on revenue and EPS but missed on Services and China, and fell 6.65% after hours. Polymarket's largest-company market flipped from Apple to NVIDIA.

item.title: Fed Holds in July 2026: What September Now Prices
item.description: The Fed held rates 9-3 on July 29 with three dissents wanting a hike. Polymarket's July market called it right - its September market now leans hike instead.

item.title: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapse Odds on Polymarket: July 29, 2026
item.description: Iran attacked a U.S. base in Jordan July 28, breaking the pause. Polymarket ceasefire odds fell 8.5-18.5c; the July 31 contract crashed then partly recovered.

item.title: Bitcoin Crash Odds on Polymarket: July 28, 2026
item.description: Bitcoin's Polymarket odds of closing above $64,000 fell from 86c to 20c overnight as BTC reclaimed $65,000 then crashed back to $63,200 on July 28, 2026.

item.title: US-Iran Strike Pause Odds on Polymarket: July 2026
item.description: Trump halted the two-week U.S. bombing campaign on Iran after July 23. Polymarket's ceasefire-pause markets jumped from 18c to 55.5c as the halt held.

item.title: Hungarian Grand Prix 2026 Odds: What Qualifying Moved
item.description: Qualifying and grid penalties reshuffled Polymarket's Hungarian Grand Prix winner market: Norris jumped to 35c as Hamilton fell to 18c on a penalty.

item.title: LeBron to Philadelphia 76ers: What the Signing Moved
item.description: LeBron James signed with the Philadelphia 76ers on July 24. Polymarket's next-team market jumped from 8c to 99.5c in a five-minute window that morning.

item.title: BetMoar vs polymarket-tui: choosing a Polymarket terminal
item.description: BetMoar is a web page styled like a terminal; polymarket-tui runs in your actual terminal. What that difference means for trust, keys, and workflow.

item.title: Israel-Iran Ceasefire Odds on Polymarket: July 2026
item.description: Iran rejected a new truce as US strikes on Iran hit a 13th night. Polymarket's dated ceasefire markets now price a coinflip on holding past July 31.

item.title: LeBron to Miami Heat Odds: What the Leaked Video Moved
item.description: A Miami Heat social-media slip posted a LeBron James press-conference video. Polymarket's Heat odds spiked to 52c on the leak, then faded to 47c a day later.

item.title: Fed Rate Decision Odds on Polymarket: July 2026
item.description: Polymarket prices an 86c chance the Fed holds rates steady at its July 29 meeting, with hike odds near 13c after a week of drift despite a cooler CPI print.

item.title: Ballon d'Or 2026 Odds: Kane Leads Yamal
item.description: Polymarket prices Harry Kane the 2026 Ballon d'Or favorite at 41c, ahead of World Cup winner Lamine Yamal at 25c and Golden Ball winner Rodri at 13.5c.

item.title: Why Spain vs Argentina 2026 resolved Draw on Polymarket
item.description: Spain lifted the 2026 World Cup, but Polymarket's match market resolved Draw. How the 90-minute rule split the final, with the in-play repricing charted.

item.title: Spain vs Argentina: 2026 World Cup final odds on Polymarket
item.description: Polymarket prices Spain at 58.6c to win the 2026 World Cup final against Argentina. Why the champion and 90-minute markets differ, and what the book shows.

item.title: What a Polymarket price means
item.description: Polymarket prices are quoted in cents but they are probabilities. What a 33c share implies, why YES and NO always sum to 100c, and how prices move as odds change.

item.title: How to read a Polymarket order book
item.description: Bids, asks, spread, depth, and ticks on Polymarket, explained. What a YES price of 33c actually means, how the YES and NO books mirror each other, and how to read one live.
